 Game Thread | Notre Dame vs. Auburn
 Notre Dame will face Auburn in the fifth-place game at the Players Era 8 tournament in Las Vegas. 
 By Matt Freeman 
 November 19, 2026 
 3.0k Views 
 Discuss 
 Share Story

 Photo by Keira Jones | ISD 
 Notre Dame (5-1) vs. Auburn (3-2)  
 Date:  November 19
 Time:  5:00 PM ET 
 Where:  Michelob Ultra Arena | Las Vegas, Nev.
 TV: ESPN | Dave O’Brien & Corey Alexander
 Spread : Auburn -3.5
 Total : 152.5
 QUICK FACTS  
 - Auburn leads the all-time series 1-0
 - The Tigers won the only meeting, 83-59, in 2003 in Brooklyn as part of the Legends Classic. 
 - This meeting will be for fifth place in the Players Era 8. Notre Dame lost to Florida and beat Rutgers, while Auburn fell to West Virginia before topping UNLV. 
 - The Fighting Irish are four wins away from 2,000 as a program.
